Proves AR-6's `notIn` operator on a `datetime` field (AR-7), with SEM-2's null-inclusion rule applying to the set-negative form. AG Grid's Set Filter has no exclude-mode wire shape, so this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point, as 036 and 038 do. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"created_at" <> ALL($1::timestamptz[])`, because `timestamptz = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). The values are ISO-8601 instants with a `Z` offset (the `customFilters` values are typed `datetimeValue`s carrying `zone: "UTC"`); the seed rows sit at `.000Z` and `.001Z` around each member to prove millisecond precision.
